title: 在休息区走走
description: 成人在岩馆休息区慢步，鞋包和水瓶整齐放凳边。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult walks slowly through a clear gym lounge between easy climbing attempts, arms swinging naturally and shoulders relaxed. The climbing wall appears far behind the empty landing area, while a bench with a towel and unbranded bottle sits beside the walking path. Show ordinary trainers and an easy pace, with no fatigue or athletic sprint. A broad window and soft late-day colors create a quietly restorative scene. Use layered cut-paper illustration with crisp overlapping shapes, shallow paper shadows, and cobalt, apricot, and ivory construction. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
